description:
Hi, I’m Kayla :) I lead global community activation within Partnerships at Ashby. Before joining a year ago, I spent 15 years in TA and was an Ashby customer. I made the move out of TA into this role, and nothing I’d learned has gone to waste. If anything, I’ve learnt even more from the community. It’s genuinely one of the most rewarding and fun roles I’ve had, and as I step into a leadership role, I’m on the hunt for someone to take over the work in EMEA and evolve it further.

We’re hiring an experienced TA Expert & Community Lead to grow one of our most successful GTM experiments: a high-touch, customer-led approach to growth. The model is already working across EMEA, built on curated events, product education and early community activation. We already work with some well-known teams in the region, and we’ve recently announced an EMEA data centre. We want to invest properly in the community there, and we know that needs to be led by someone local. Someone who knows the market, speaks the language and understands how TA teams in the region actually work. You’ll own the DACH community end to end, from customer breakfasts and curated experiences to enablement sessions and product demos.

This role suits someone who has worked with Ashby All-in-One, has a solid background in TA, and cares about tools, process, hospitality and community building. It also works well for TA people who still love the work but want to use what they know somewhere new. You’ll work closely with Sales, CS and Product Marketing, own a region end-to-end, and see how community connects to pipeline and retention.

A quick summary on travel, since it’s usually the first question and we know it means time away from home: you’ll have events in Germany regularly, plus travel to another DACH (or wider EMEA) country every month, usually for around four days. There is flex, though. I’m a mum of three, and in this role, I’ve been able to stay home and take meaningful time off during every school holiday. We plan the calendar well in advance, so you’ll know what’s coming and can sort things at home with plenty of notice.

It’s also one of the best parts of the job. I’ve met some amazing people and had some really cool experiences along the way, from hosting a dinner cruise on the Seine and a TA leader workshop with a partner at the Shangri-La Paris, to spending time in customers’ offices in Stockholm, our company offsite in Playa Del Carmen, and hosting the mainstage at our first Ashby One London.

What you’ll do

  • Lead DACH Community Events

    • Run community events across target DACH markets. Event types might include:

      • Customer learning breakfasts

      • A mixed ecosystem event for customers and prospects

      • Partner cocktail events or roundtables co-hosted with local ecosystem players

    • Build and nurture relationships with TA leaders

    • Partner with Event Ops on venue selection, invites, and post-event recaps

    • Drive improvement and reimagine how we can show up in a very meaningful way for the community

  • Drive Customer Education

    • Become an Expert in Ashby + TA leader needs to curate relevant content

    • Design and lead live sessions that help customers activate key Ashby features and keep customers ahead on key TA trends and topics

    • Partner with CS and Product Marketing teams on the Ashby Hidden Gems program

    • Develop and distribute product tips, dashboards, and templates to increase customer sophistication

  • Expand EMEA Community and Customer Advocacy

    • Help Ashby deepen its brand and trust by showing up consistently and thoughtfully

    • Participate in and help advise on content for ACE (Ashby Customer Expert) events when we bring the program to EMEA

    • Partner with GTM teams on prospect and customer onsite visits

    • Moderate panels, attend events, and build a presence at industry gatherings

Who you’ll work with

You’ll report directly to me, but work closely with myself and Willem, who has pioneered what community growth looks like at Ashby. Within partnerships, you’ll also work closely with Katie to scale trusted community partner relationships and Louise to bring Owned Community experiences, like Ashby Cafe, to life. You’ll also partner day to day with our EMEA Sales and CS teams, who know our customers and prospects best and help shape who we bring into the room.

About You

We think the ideal person for this role will have experience and skills that look something like this:

  • You’ve been an Ashby power user or at least very familiar with Ashby and seen its benefits first-hand—someone who knows the product and Ashby community, champions good recruiting practices, and isn’t afraid to dive into dashboards, workflows, or templates

  • You’ve built a reputation inside organizations as the go-to expert on TA process and tooling

  • You’re a strong communicator—whether facilitating a breakfast, writing a post-event summary, or helping a customer understand how to build a dashboard

  • You love curating and connecting people and ideas. You get energy from hosting, matchmaking, and finding smart formats to share what works

  • You’re excited about being on the road ~2x/month and tapping into your existing network (and growing it!) in the TA space

  • You have strong business acumen. You understand how community supports the wider business and work well with Sales and CS to make sure our programs are reaching the right people

  • You’re entrepreneurial and experimental in nature. You’re not looking for rigid playbooks; you want room to try new formats and evolve what ‘great’ looks like. You come prepared with AI tools / automations that help us execute faster while maintaining quality.

  • You believe in unreasonable hospitality—the idea that going above and beyond for a customer doesn’t just build goodwill, it builds momentum.

  • You’re fluent in German and English, and have a strong understanding of how hiring works in DACH

This Role Probably Isn't Right If ...

  • You’re not excited about hosting or don’t enjoy the details of curating small, thoughtful gatherings

  • You hate writing and have difficulty building a cohesive brief (this is a very important skill at Ashby)

  • You don’t enjoy travelling and building new connections while you’re at it

  • You’ve never had hands-on TA experience

  • You’ve never used Ashby and aren’t familiar with modern TA systems and practices

  • You prefer working from a very established playbook and are uncomfortable with ambiguity or iteration

  • You’re uncomfortable with moderating discussions or being a speaker

  • You’d rather focus purely on the community side and aren’t keen to understand how it connects to the wider business

  • You only have an ‘events background’. For this role, we need folks with deep knowledge of the TA ecosystem and a proven network in major city hubs across the DACH region

  • You aren’t fluent in both German and English

Interview Plan

  • Recruiter Screen with Kayla/Willem - 30 minutes

  • Hiring Manager Interview with Kayla - 45 minutes

  • Cross-functional Panel - 1 hour

  • Assignment (written) - 2 hours

    • Followed by Assignment Review with Kayla - 30 Minutes

  • Final Round - 1-1.5 hours

Benefits

  • Compelling benefits offerings, location dependent

  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.

  • Unlimited PTO with four weeks recommended per year. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it 😅.

  • Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!

  • $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

Ashby’s success hinges on hiring great people and creating an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work. We’re being deliberate about building that environment from the ground up. I hope that excites you enough to apply.

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.
